answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks sybil farming at the gate. Each agent that wants a paid slot posts 0.05 POA, which is burned, never refunded, a small whisper of value gone for good. One honest agent pays once and works for weeks. A forger running 1,000 fake identities must burn 1,000 x 0.05 = 50 POA up front, with the cost rising linearly per identity. Forged fleets freeze in a cold tundra of rising costs, while the honest slot earns its nectar.
